Subject: Request to move next-week POC demo — CFO travel & planning blackout

Hi Kimberly,

Quick note — the CFO unexpectedly added travel next week and Finance has declared a short planning blackout while they finalize FY27 allocations. That means folks who need to attend (CFO, head of procurement) will be unavailable between Tue 24 Nov and Tue 30 Nov.

We still want the POC, but can you push our demo out a week so it's in the window after the planning blackout? Preferable windows for us: Thu Dec 2 (afternoon PT) or Wed Dec 8 (morning PT).

Also: is there any short pre-demo collateral (one-pager on latency/cost profile for the generative pipeline) you can send so our procurement folks can review before the meeting?

Thanks,
